description: A repeat of our PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST still queued when the peer's accept arrives is withdrawn and never sent.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ and at 0 sends "ping" to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3; the CAS calls and the request goes out at 75000, and cas.link_request/0.0.1.3 runs from 80550 (B-0203, B-0400). It expires at 140550 with no answer, so the request is sent again (B-0221, B-0222): queued, and csma.lbt_wait starts, 3000 ms. At 141000 the peer's burst starts, which holds our transmission (csma.lbt_wait cancelled), and at 142000 it carries PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED (octet 22) answering our first request: the link is made (B-0219), link_state linked, the soft link established and "ping" passed down (A-0194). The repeat still waiting in the DTS answers nothing now and the peer, which holds the link, would read it as a new call (B-0452), so the CAS withdraws it and the DTS drops it, none of it having been placed (B-0453). The burst ends at 143000; csma.vdcd_end 4000, LBT rule 1, contention 12000 ms, and at 159000 the transmission carries only DATA-ONLY FSN 0 with "ping" and a PADDING in the spare bytes of its second block (C-1154), with no PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST. dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts with the derived answer wait when it has ended, at 169350 (C-1120). Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15 then 4: contention waits 45000 then 12000 ms (K-0080). Settings: cas.max_links, cas.link_request_timeout_ms 60000, cas.link_request_retries and cas.first_data_timeout_ms 120000. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly, C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived from the answer wait (A-0321). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
